svg.text: HOW TO MAKE THEM AND HOW THEY FIT

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the wire 700 mm longer than the eye to eye length (loop,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tensioner and tail). Tape both ends before cutting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End 1: loop the wire round a thimble and fit two wire rope clips,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: saddles on the long side, nuts torqued to the clip maker's figure.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End 2: pass the wire through the hand tensioner as its maker shows.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clip a snap hook to the thimble and one to the tensioner's eye.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the length with the tensioner let out to the eye to eye length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Label each cable (gable, wall, roof) on a tag at end 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: snap hooks clip to the anchor eyes at the feet and to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rings on the cable bolts; pull snug with the tensioner only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each clip is tight after one pull of 300 N by hand scale.
